title: Agent Result
description: Contract output written by a BYO agent to /app/agent_run/result.json. The harness pulls this back into logs/experiment_<uuid>/agent_run/result.json and feeds it through utils.run_artifacts.normalize_agent_result. See documentation/proposals/agent_decoupling/06_design.md for the full contract.

status.description: Run terminal status. 'completed' = agent finished cleanly. 'timeout' = harness wall-clock kill fired. 'error' = agent or harness raised. 'dry_run' and 'unknown' are harness-internal statuses accepted for back-compat with non-contract code paths.

turns_taken.description: Number of agent loop iterations. CLI agents that don't expose a turn count may report 1 (single CLI invocation).

cost_usd.description: Total LLM cost for this run in USD.

model.description: Model id actually used (echoes task.json.model unless the CLI/provider remapped it).

final_message.description: Last assistant message text. Source per agent: codex CodexCLIResult.output_text; claude-code last assistant event; custom final assistant message.

error_traceback.description: Populated only when status='error'. Stack trace or decoder message for malformed result.json.

tool_call_count.description: Total number of tool invocations across the run.

unique_tools.description: Distinct tool names invoked during the run.

token_totals.description: Aggregate token counts. Required for cost analysis even when cost_usd is 0 (unregistered models).

exit_code.description: Process exit code for the agent's /run-agent.sh. Useful when status='error'.
